arguments.text: Calibration: CP 171 W paddle, HR model rest 74, ceiling 167, creep 4/10min, HR at 50/65/80/90/100% CP = 115/127/138/146/153, HR separates up to 1.2 CP (good). Blade eff steep at low rate (48:0.44, 50:0.52, 56:0.71, 62:0.74, 66:0.66). S1 (18C, feels good): warm-up HR gap +2..3 bpm vs model, HR share ~0.03-0.04 above pace share. Before first turn current unknown.

arguments.why: check first steady stretch: HR vs pace agreement, ask conditions

text: Keeping combined/agree: heart rate matches the calibration model within 3 bpm and pace agrees in the warm-up; current not yet known before the first turn.
Guide unchanged (combined, agree). Will re-check at minute 12.

arguments.text: S1 min 8-12: HR matched model within 1 bpm at tempo/threshold (good strap, no heat). Current est small (+0.06-0.08 m/s after turn at ~min 10). Min 12: strap locked onto stroke rate (63.9 = rate); asked fix_strap at 12.3. Plausibility check on, so pace carries meanwhile.

text: Strap locked on stroke rate; paddler re-seated it. Plausibility check drops the bad readings so pace carries the display. Guide unchanged.

arguments.why: check whether strap fix worked; re-ask fix_strap if still locked on rate

text: Strap fix requested at 12.3; pace carries the display meanwhile. Re-checking at 15.

arguments.why: check stretch 23-35: HR vs pace agreement, drift

text: Strap fix worked (min 14 HR within 2 bpm of model). Guide unchanged.
Strap reading normally again; both routes agree at threshold. Guide unchanged.

arguments.text: S1 min 21-26 (out leg): HR 4-10 bpm BELOW model at both recovery and the 2nd hard stretch, strap fine, steady. Warm-up (out leg, current unknown) HR was +3 above. Pattern fits current reversing (now helping on out leg) while computer still says -0.08 against -> pace overestimates. Not tiredness pattern (easy HR not raised). Switched combine to hr_first at 26.

arguments.why: after next turn: did current estimate update and pace come back in line with HR?

text: Heart rate first: pace looks inflated by a lagging current estimate on this leg.

arguments.text: S1 min 27 turn: current est jumped from -0.08 to ~+0.05 (back leg); after turn pace and HR closer (HR gap -2..-4, both tempo ~0.80-0.86). Supports: pace off when current shifts, HR reliable for this paddler at 18C. Default for next sessions: combined hr_first + plausibility check.

text: Both routes agree on tempo after the turn; keeping heart rate first.

arguments.text: S1 history: HR-minus-model gap drifted +3 (min 0-8) -> -4 (20-35) -> -6 (cool-down 35-40): either paddler creeps less than model 4/10min or current shifts. S2 (17C, 61 min, one long stretch 6-56, feels fine): warm-up gap already -6 at min 1-5 (no creep yet), current unknown before first turn.

arguments.why: after first turn: compare HR gap with current estimate

text: Heart rate first for now; will compare with pace once the current is known after the first turn.

arguments.text: S2 turn ~min 9: current est -0.15 on back leg (so it HELPED the out leg ~0.15; pace overestimated before the turn: out-leg pace 0.74 vs HR 0.61). After turn HR still ~0.05 share below pace (gap -4). Long endurance stretch, HR share near 0.55 boundary -> switched to agree (average) at 12. Watch: HR may drift low if paddler creeps less than model.

arguments.why: check drift of HR vs pace over the long stretch

text: Averaging the two routes for the long endurance stretch.

arguments.text: S2 analysis: warm-up gap -6 was the current (helped out leg ~0.13). After turn, HR gap grows ~-2.7 (min12) -> -5 (min24): fits paddler creeping ~2 bpm/10min, HALF the model 4/10. Pace power drifts 107->100W at steady plan (blade eff fatigue). Truth ~0.62. Set hr_offset -5 at min 24 (agree). Offset must grow ~-2 per 10 min within a session and RESET to ~0 at next session start.

arguments.why: raise hr offset magnitude for slower creep (about -8 by min 40)

text: Heart-rate offset -5 bpm for this paddler slower-than-modelled creep; both routes now read endurance at about 0.61.

arguments.text: S2 min 38: HR gap vs model now -6..-8 (min 34-37), HR flat ~127 since min 13 while pace power 107->96 W. Same in-session drift as S1 (~-2 bpm per 10 min): paddler creep ~2/10min not 4. Turn at min 38 made the current estimate lag (pace 0.51 out leg), so hr_first with offset -8 for the rest of the long stretch.

arguments.why: raise offset to about -10 for creep; consider back to agree once current settled

text: Heart rate first with an 8 bpm correction while the current estimate settles after the turn.

arguments.text: S2 min 43-47: HR rose to 134, gap steady ~-6 (drift stopped); with offset -8 HR share ~0.61, pace ~0.59, both endurance. Kept hr_first offset -8 through turn at 47. NEXT SESSION START: reset hr_offset to ~0 (gap near 0 early in session), re-check.

text: Both routes read endurance; keeping heart rate first through the turn.

arguments.text: S3 (16C, 51 min, stretch 6-46, feels Good): warm-up GPS only 2.1 at rate 52 (S1/S2 ~2.4), pace 0.35 vs HR 0.51 (gap +12 bpm vs model at easy). Before first turn. Suspect strong current against out leg (pace underestimates) and/or tiredness despite Good. Reset offset to 0, agree mode at min 6.

text: Offset reset; averaging routes until the current and the heart-rate gap are understood.

arguments.text: S3 min 8: paddler says water moving AGAINST on the way out -> pace underestimates until first turn. Set hr_first (offset 0). Re-check gap after turn: if HR still well above model, consider tiredness (HR high at easy, lower CP).

arguments.why: after first turn: compare HR and pace with the current known

text: Heart rate first while the current against the out leg is unmeasured.

arguments.text: S3 min 11 turn: current est +0.26 helping back leg (strong; out-leg pace was ~0.15 share too low). After turn HR gap -3 at 110 W -> no tiredness, the warm-up +12 gap was the current. Min 12: strap locked on stroke rate again (62); asked fix_strap at 13.

text: Strap re-seated; pace carries the display meanwhile.
Current now measured; averaging both routes (both endurance).

arguments.why: check HR creep drift and pace fatigue drift late in the stretch

text: Strap back; both routes endurance (0.62-0.69). Guide unchanged.

arguments.text: S3 min 30: HR gap drifted to -6.5 (HR share 0.58 vs pace 0.66), same slow-creep pattern as S1/S2. Set offset -5 at min 32 (agree). Current est flips sign at each turn, ~0.27 m/s, against out leg. RESET offset to 0 at next session start.

text: Small heart-rate correction for the slower creep; both routes endurance.

arguments.text: S4 (18C, 53 min, changes 8/23/33/38/48): paddler says water moving WITH us on the way out -> pace overestimates until first turn (warm-up pace 0.71 vs HR 0.57). Reset offset 0, hr_first at min 8.

arguments.why: after first turn: compare routes with the current known

text: Heart rate first while the current helping the out leg is unmeasured.

arguments.text: S4 turn ~min 9: current est -0.19 against back leg. Back leg min 10-12: pace 0.79-0.83 (tempo), HR 0.72-0.75, gap -5..-6 already early. HR has read 0.04-0.08 below pace after the turn in every session (S1 later, S2, S3, S4). Could be fitness gain (CP today higher) or slower creep. Switched to agree (avg ~0.77 tempo) at 13.

arguments.why: check stretch 23-33 after change of effort

text: Averaging the routes now the current is measured; reads tempo.

arguments.text: S4 min 23-26: threshold stretch, rate 64, pace 0.92-0.93, HR 0.89-0.90 (gap only -2.5..-3 here), agree -> threshold. HR route matches pace much better at threshold than at endurance/tempo for this paddler.

text: Both routes near threshold; guide unchanged.

arguments.text: S4 min 33-38 above-threshold (rate 66, pace 1.10, HR 1.00 lagging); min 38-41 endurance (rate 62, pace 0.67-0.69, HR 0.58-0.61, gap -8). Agree average ~0.64 endurance. Guide end of S4: combined agree, offset 0, cp_scale 1.

text: Both routes endurance after the hard piece; guide unchanged.

arguments.text: S5 (22C WARM, 43 min, intervals ~4 on/2 off from 8 to 38): water WITH us out, gusty breeze rising ON THE NOSE out (pace underestimates out leg into wind, overestimates back leg with tailwind). Heat should push HR up at every effort and grow creep. Warm-up GPS fell 3.02->2.62 at rate 52 (wind rising). Agree mode, offset 0 at min 8.

arguments.why: compare routes 3 min into first interval; ask feel

text: Averaging both routes for now; will compare them three minutes into the first interval.

arguments.text: S5 interval 1 (8-12, rate 66, feels Good): back leg (tailwind, current est -0.19 against) pace 174-177 W = 1.02-1.04 and falling; HR 162-163 = 1.06-1.07 with gap +4 (cool sessions were -3..-8, so heat adds ~+8 bpm). S4 rate-66 piece was pace 1.10. Truth near the 1.05 boundary; agree kept. Next: compare out-leg (headwind) pace in interval 2.

arguments.why: interval 2 (14-18): compare pace on the other leg and HR heat bias

text: Keeping the average of both routes; heat raises heart rate and the wind biases pace by leg, so neither is clean alone.

arguments.note: Gusty wind today: pace-based effort is unreliable, display uses heart rate. In the heat it may read a touch high.

arguments.text: S5 min 14-16: current est jumped to -0.30 (gusts absorbed), pace route 1.35-1.42 for a rate-66 interval = broken. HR 162-167 ~1.06-1.10, consistent with S4 rate-66 piece (~1.08) + small heat bias (+2..5 bpm). Set mode=hr (no pace fallback: cannot tell is safer than a broken pace) at 16.3.

arguments.why: interval 4 (26-30): check heat creep in HR and rest-stretch readings

text: Display on heart rate only: pace is distorted by the gusts and a jumping current estimate.

arguments.text: S5 interval 4 (26-30): pace back to 182-188 W (1.07-1.10), HR 167-171 gap -1..-2 -> work truth ~1.08 above threshold; HR mode right. Rest min 25: HR 0.53 vs pace 0.48 (heat gap +4..+7 at easy). Plan for cool-down (38-43): heat-raised HR may read endurance; switch to agree with offset ~+5.

arguments.why: cool-down from 38: correct heat bias for easy effort

text: Heart-rate mode reads the intervals as above threshold, matching pace this interval; guide unchanged.

arguments.note: Cool-down: heart rate runs a little high in the heat, display averages heart rate and pace.

arguments.text: S5 interval 5 (32-36): HR 1.09-1.11 (heat gap +6..+9 growing), pace 0.99-1.01 (fatigue). Cool-down from 38: HR 0.46-0.50, pace 0.44-0.47; set agree + offset +3 for heat at 38.5. Summary: paddler HR runs ~3-8 bpm under calibration model in cool water, creeps slower; strap locks on stroke rate (S1, S3); currents 0.1-0.3 m/s bias pace before first turn.

text: Cool-down reads recovery on both routes; averaging with a small heat correction.
